title: stepdoc generic procedure
description: The generic procedure of each test (--stepdoc-generic): one entry per test, all its cases (parameter sets, strategy vectors) in one, without results.

test_id.description: pytest node id without the parameter id, e.g. tests/api/test_users.py::TestUsers::test_create

test_name.description: The test function's name, e.g. test_create

test_file.description: The test file's name, e.g. test_users.py

test_path.description: The test file's path relative to the pytest root, e.g. tests/api/test_users.py

doc.description: The test function's docstring, as in the run record (DOC-1)

values.description: The values the cases used, or the adapter's domain (integer 0 … 4095)

strategy.description: The generator of the cases' values, when an adapter names it

cases.description: How many cases (runs) this entry stands for

variants.description: Only when the cases took different paths: each path of the procedure section with the cases (parameter ids) that took it. steps holds the first one

number.description: 1, 1.2, S1, T1.1, P1; null for an entry outside any step

text.description: The line as the procedure shows it, without its number

label.description: A named check's name in quotes

result.description: A read bound to a name: <rdata>

note.description: note= of a step or repeat, a check's note, or 'value from this run' on an action

applied_in.description: A pre-condition a shared fixture applied for that earlier test

branches.description: A guarded check's branches (CHK-12, pytest-verifier's guard), in order, the default last

condition.description: The condition as written in the guard(...) call

branch_label.description: The branch's label; for a branch without a known condition, what names it

text.description: The branch's check as the procedure shows it, without the opening

source.description: The check's source, when it can be worded no other way
